Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_CarbonPowder: Ground charcoal or coke used as an abstract feedstock for field powder.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_HeavyPistolBody: A large pistol projectile and casing paired for assembly with field powder.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_MineralSalts: Crushed mineral feedstock for field ammunition. This is a game abstraction, not a real chemical formula.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_NitrogenousMix: An abstract field-powder component prepared from compost or fertilizer. Not a real chemical formula.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_Press: A hand-operated wood-and-iron press. Place it on a table to shape cartridge bodies and assemble ammunition.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_Propellant: An ammunition-only field powder for assembling rounds. It does not replace vanilla gunpowder for explosives.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_RifleBody: A rifle projectile and casing paired for assembly with field powder.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_ShotgunBody: A shot charge and hull paired for assembly with field powder.
Tooltip_item_AuxAmmo_SmallPistolBody: A small pistol projectile and casing paired for assembly with field powder.
